Query CrateDB as the signed-in user

Source: R/backend__cratedb.R
oauth_db_cratedb_api.Rd

Run SQL through CrateDB's HTTPS interface using the visitor's current JWT access token. CrateDB validates the token, maps it to a database user and enforces that user's privileges.

Usage

oauth_db_cratedb_api(
  authorization,
  url,
  schema = NULL,
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = character(),
  min_valid_for = 60,
  timeout = 300,
  ca_bundle = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

auth$connection from a shinyOAuth server module, without parentheses. To select a saved authorization, pass a function that calls auth$connection(id).

url

HTTPS SQL endpoint, including /_sql and any proxy prefix.

schema

Default schema, or NULL for CrateDB's doc default.

target

Token target name in the shinyOAuth client. NULL uses its default token, including for clients without named targets.

required_scopes

Additional permissions to check before use. Request consent and set the client's permission requirements in shinyOAuth.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

timeout

Maximum seconds for one HTTP operation.

ca_bundle

Optional trusted CA certificate bundle path.

session

Shiny session. Inferred when the helper is created in server().

Value

An R6 client with these methods:

  • $query(sql, parameters = list(), raw = FALSE) returns a data frame, or the complete result with metadata when raw = TRUE.

  • $execute(sql, parameters = list()) runs a statement and invisibly returns its affected row count (-1 when unknown).

Details

Configure CrateDB's JWT authentication for HTTP and a database user whose JWT properties match the token's iss, username and aud claims. The provider must issue a compatible access token; an ordinary browser login or an ID token does not establish database access.

Create this client inside server(). shinyOAuth obtains or renews a token before each request. Account changes, missing permissions, sign-out and session end stop local access; results arriving after an authorization change are discarded. SQL submissions are never retried, including 401 responses, because even a query can have side effects. A timed-out query may continue on the server.

Parameters and results

Use $1, $2, ... or ? placeholders with an unnamed list of positional parameters. Values are sent separately in CrateDB's JSON args array. Scalars, missing values, arrays and named-list objects are supported. Dates and timestamps become ISO strings; cast their placeholders to the desired SQL type. Use strings and SQL casts for exact large integers and decimals. Non-finite numeric parameters are rejected.

BIGINT and NUMERIC columns are character vectors, preserving every digit. Smaller integers and floating-point values become R numbers, booleans become logical, and text becomes character. Timestamps and dates retain their epoch-millisecond strings. Arrays, objects and other complex types remain list columns, with JSON numbers preserved as strings. Empty results keep their column types and duplicate column names are preserved.

raw = TRUE returns metadata and rows, preserving numeric values within rows as strings. HTTP failures expose the HTTP status without including server messages, SQL text or credentials.

See also

vignette("cratedb", package = "shinyOAuthDB"). oauth_db_demo() runs a local CrateDB and Keycloak example.

Other platform API clients: oauth_db_bigquery_api(), oauth_db_clickhouse_api(), oauth_db_databricks_api(), oauth_db_fabric_api(), oauth_db_libsql_api(), oauth_db_opensearch_api(), oauth_db_oracle_ords_api(), oauth_db_postgrest_api(), oauth_db_salesforce_api(), oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(), oauth_db_supabase_api()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crate <- oauth_db_cratedb_api(auth$connection,
  url = "https://crate.example.org:4200/_sql", schema = "doc")
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  crate$query("SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE country = $1 LIMIT 20",
    parameters = list("NL"))
})
} # }
